, technology monitoring, risk warning, and emergency response mechanisms to effectively prevent issues such as the use of artificial intelligence for forgery and fraud, academic dishonesty, exam-oriented competition, and privacy leaks. 

We must ensure that the leadership of the Party is integrated throughout the entire process of "artificial intelligence + education," strengthening organizational leadership, overall planning, guidance, supervision, and condition guarantees. The education department is responsible for formulating action plans and coordinating implementation; the development and reform department will enhance overall coordination and support the construction of projects that meet requirements; the science and technology department will focus on strengthening research layouts in key areas; the industrial and information technology and data management departments will provide policy support to promote open-source and open access as well as data interconnectivity. Localities and schools should incorporate "artificial intelligence + education" into their development plans, develop implementation plans that align with their actual situations, and actively carry out application demonstrations. We will strengthen the construction of think tanks and consulting institutions, enhance policy and strategic research, frontline work guidance, and provide suggestions. We will organize specialized training to improve the AI leadership capabilities of management personnel. We will deeply implement pilot actions for empowering education with artificial intelligence, establish a data-based normalized application supervision mechanism, and promptly summarize and promote excellent experiences and practices.
